module: Expected yaw provider (type "auxiliary", defaultOrder 80, providerOrder 20) for the yawControl supervisor. It estimates the yaw rate the driver is requesting using the bicycle model with cornering stiffness (front wheel angle, wheelbase, characteristic speed), limited by a maximum lateral acceleration. Registers via yawControl.registerYawProvider; if yawControl is absent, it disables itself.
notes: Formula: min( |frontWheelAngle| / wheelbase * v / (1 + v² / vc²), maxLateralAcceleration / v ) with v = virtual speed if virtualSpeed is fully trusted (>= 1) otherwise wheel speed. The result is always positive (the sign is handled by yawControl).

Inconsistency: yawControl calls yawProvider.calculateExpectedYaw(speed, dt), but the function is declared calculateExpectedYaw(dt): the dt parameter actually receives the speed. Harmless since it is not used.
Modifiable parameters: isEnabled, maxLateralAcceleration. isEnabled is not checked in calculateExpectedYaw (the provider always answers).

isActive.desc: True after init, false if yawControl is absent.

initSecondStage.desc: Registers with yawControl and reads maxLateralAcceleration.

calculateExpectedYaw.desc: Returns the expected yaw rate (rad/s, positive) from the front wheel angle and the speed; called by yawControl at every fixed step.

dt.desc: Declared as dt but receives the speed (see notes); unused.

registerCMU.desc: Stores the reference to the CMU.

getConfig.desc: Returns a copy of the configuration.

sendConfigData.desc: Sends the configuration to the CMU.
